**Node.js 22.0.0 GitHub release page**

1. **Release tag (primary)** — [github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)  
   2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current), by @RafaelGSS and @marco-ippolito. Signed tag `v22.0.0` (`12fb157`). Highlights: `require()` of synchronous ESM graphs, WebSocket client, V8 updates. LTS planned for October 2024. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

2. **Release notes source (nodejs.org blog markdown)** — [nodejs/nodejs.org `v22.0.0.md`](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)  
   Full blog post text, installers, SHASUMs, and commit list. Title: “Node.js 22.0.0 (Current)”; author Rafael Gonzaga. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)

3. **Announcement source** — [nodejs/nodejs.org `v22-release-announce.md`](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce.md)  
   “Node.js 22 is now available!” Notable changes: V8 12.4, Maglev on by default, `--experimental-require-module`. Points to the blog post and download page. [[3]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce.md)

4. **V22 changelog** — [node/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)  
   Line-item changelog for the 22.x line in the node repo. [[4]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)

5. **All node releases** — [github.com/nodejs/node/releases](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases)  
   Current release index (later 22.x “Jod” LTS builds appear here; 22.0.0 is the original Current release). [[5]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases)

6. **Tags index** — [github.com/nodejs/node/tags](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)  
   Signed release tags, including later v22.x. [[6]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)

**Notable changes called out on the 22.0.0 notes**

- Drop import assertions; watch mode stable; faster `AbortSignal` creation. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)
- Semver-major: V8 12.4.254.14, WebSocket enabled by default, higher stream `highWaterMark`, Maglev enabled. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)
- npm upgraded to 10.5.1 among dependency updates. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)
